correctness.rationale: Integer circle maps preserve Haar measure and their transfer operators satisfy total-variation contraction by 1/m. On centered BV, P_epsilon=(1-epsilon)P_a+epsilon P_b has uniform geometric norm contraction; h=(I-P)^-1 phi exists with bounded BV norm. The Green–Kubo variance is ||h||_2^2-||P h||_2^2; the reversed stationary Markov chain gives a bounded martingale-coboundary CLT with ergodic conditional variance. At positive mixing weights zero conditional variance implies a common value on every inverse branch, yielding H(ax)=H(bx) a.e. Writing a/gcd=r,b/gcd=s coprime, Fourier frequency comparison c_k=0 unless s divides k, else c_k=c_{rk/s}; repeated s-divisibility forces every nonzero Fourier coefficient zero and H constant. Therefore only phi=0 has zero variance. For phi=psi-U_a psi, telescoping gives h0=-U_a psi and P_a h0=-psi; differentiating the Poisson resolvent/variance at epsilon=0 cancels h0 derivative terms and gives exactly ||U_a psi-U_b psi||_2^2>0. Exact Fourier cosine computations independently confirmed sigma^2=epsilon for (a,b)=(2,3),(3,2),(6,10) and sigma^2=epsilon-epsilon^2 for (4,2) over rational test probabilities. These finite tests are diagnostics; the BV/CLT conclusion is analytic.

value.rationale: This cleanly characterizes noise-induced destruction of deterministic zero-variance obstructions for the natural Bernoulli random-beta family, with a positive exact linear coefficient and an arithmetic resonance boundary. The coefficient quantifies sensitivity of CLT fluctuations rather than merely invoking generic differentiability.

limitations: Mean-zero real BV on circle; annealed stationary Lebesgue probability, iid two integer slopes; eps in (0,1) for variance positivity.
